# 1 Samuel Chapter 3 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 3

---

### Verse 1 — "precious" vs. "rare"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the word of the LORD was precious"
- **PNEUMA:** "messages from the LORD were rare"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "rare" — yaqar's contextual meaning is about scarcity here.

### Verse 7 — "know the LORD"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "did not yet know the LORD"
- **PNEUMA:** "had not yet come to know the LORD personally"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET/LOGOS. "Personally" is accurate but not in the Hebrew.

### Verse 13 — "bringing a curse upon themselves" vs. "blaspheming God"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "bringing a curse upon themselves"
- **PNEUMA:** "blaspheming God"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET/LOGOS (Leningrad Codex reading), noting tiqqun tradition.

### Verse 13 — "rebuke" vs. "restrain"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "rebuke"
- **PNEUMA:** "restrain"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "restrain" — the Hebrew verb conveys active restraint, not just verbal rebuke.

### Verse 17 — oath formula
- **EMET:** "Thus may God do to you and thus may He add"
- **LOGOS:** "May God do thus to you and more also"
- **PNEUMA:** "May God deal with you severely"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows PNEUMA for readability.

### Verse 19 — "words falling to the ground"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "let none of his words fall to the ground"
- **PNEUMA:** "confirmed every word Samuel spoke"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows LOGOS — the Hebrew idiom is vivid and worth preserving.

— SOPHIA
